scalars.scalar_value: Three (3) years supervisory experience in radiation oncology

items.item_text: Must possess and maintain a current Therapeutic Radiology license issued by the state of California (RRTT).

Must possess and maintain one of the following certificates: Current Registered Technologist Radiography ARRT (RTR) Registered Technologist Bone Densitometry (RTBD) Registered Technologist Computed Tomography (RTCT) Registered Technologist Cardio Interventional Radiography (RTCV) Registered Technologist Mammography (RTM) Registered Technologist Magnetic Resonance Imaging (RTMR) Registered Technologist Nuclear Medicine Technology (RTN) Registered Technologist Quality Management (RTQM) Registered Technologist Radiation Therapy (RTT) Registered Technologist Vascular Interventional Rad (RTVI) Registered Technologist Vascular Sonography (RTVS)
Must possess and maintain a current Basic Life Support (BLS) certificate
Three (3) years supervisory experience in radiation oncology
Ensuring the deliver of specific prescribed radiation treatment procedures
Use of photon and electron beams
Performance of simulation procedures, dosimetry, calculations, and delivery of ionizing radiation
Current Registered Technologist Radiography ARRT (RTR)
Registered Technologist Bone Densitometry (RTBD)
Registered Technologist Computed Tomography (RTCT)
Registered Technologist Cardio Interventional Radiography (RTCV)
Registered Technologist Mammography (RTM)
Registered Technologist Magnetic Resonance Imaging (RTMR)
Registered Technologist Nuclear Medicine Technology (RTN)
Registered Technologist Quality Management (RTQM)
Registered Technologist Radiation Therapy (RTT)
Registered Technologist Vascular Interventional Rad (RTVI)
Registered Technologist Vascular Sonography (RTVS)
Communicate effectively both orally and in writing to diverse groups and individuals
Plan, organize and manage the work of others
Delegate responsibilities effectively
Exercise good judgment and tact in providing strong leadership guidance and assistance
Demonstrated skill in the use of knowledge of radiation therapy equipment i.e. linear accelerators simulators dosimetry and block cutting
Knowledge of state and federal regulations and JCAHO standards
